original.text: ※ 입학 시 배부된 학사안내서, 학사게시판 - 자주묻는질문 게시글 내 체크리스트 등을 확인하여 본인의 수료/ 졸업 요건 충족 여부를 반드시 확인하시기 바랍니다.
1. 수료예정자
가. 수료 신청은 따로 받지 않으며 석사·박사 4학기 이상 등록하고 수료에 필요한 학점을 취득한 경우, 석박사통합과정 6학기 이상 등록하고 수료에 필요한 학점을 취득한 경우 수료 사정 대상자가 됩니다.​​ 이에 수료하는 학기라고 생각되는 경우 반드시 명단에 자신의 이름이 있는지 확인해야 합니다.
나. 미수료 확인서: 제출대상자에게 유선 안내 예정, 2026. 1. 14.(수)까지​ 미수료 확인서(첨부파일 참고) 제출 필요
다. 수료예정자 명단: 첨부파일(수료 및 학위수여 예정자) 참고
※ 수료예정자 중 이번 학기 수료를 원하지 않을 경우, 2026. 1. 14.(수)까지​ 수료유예원(첨부파일 참고)을 제출하여 주시기 바랍니다.
기한 내 연락이 없는 경우 이상이 없는 것으로 간주하여 진행할 예정입니다.

★ (필독) 중요! ★
1. 첨부파일과 같이 수료/ 졸업 예정자 명단이 공지 되었으나,
행정실의 수료 / 졸업 요건 검토 결과에 따라 명단에서 제외 또는 추가될 수 있으며 변동사항이 발생할 수 있는 점 참고 부탁드립니다.
※ 타학과(또는 학부과목) 이수 승인 신청서 제출 여부/ 수료 요건 충족 여부 등 최종 검토 진행 중
이에 학생 본인께서도 반드시 학사게시판 - 자주 묻는 질문 - 학사안내서 및 수료 자가진단 체크리스트를 확인하여 주시기 바랍니다.
2. 현재까지 수강하신 과목 중 타학과(또는 학부과목)에 대해 이수 승인 신청서를 제출하지 않으신 분들께서는 지금이라도 반드시 제출하여 주시기 바랍니다.
3. 이번학기 수료대상자 명단에 있으나 수료 유예하고 싶으신 경우, 수료대상자로 생각되나 명단에 없으신 경우, 수료요건 미충족으로 판단되나 명단에 있는 경우, 졸업 대상자이나 명단에 없는 경우 등 특이사항이 있는 모든 분들께서는 반드시 담당자(이소연 직원)에게 말씀하여 주시기 바랍니다.

original.text: 라. 미수료/수료예정자 유의사항
'미수료 확인서' 또는 '수료유예원'을 제출할 경우, 규정학기 초과자로서 다음 학기에 반드시 등록해야 합니다.(3학점 이하: 등록금 1/2 납부. 4학점 이상: 등록금 전액 납부). '규정학기 초과자'는 수강신청 취소해서 0학점 되면 미등록 제적되므로 유의하여 주시기 바랍니다.
규정학기 초과자: (재학생)석사·박사: 5학기부터, (재학생)석박통합 9학기부터
※ 수강신청 또는 휴학을 하지 않을 경우 제적 처리됨
휴학생 신분으로는 졸업이나 수료를 할 수 없음
석박통합과정은 8학기까지 등록금 전액 납부
라. 참고: 논문제출기한 석사 수료 후 4년 이내, 박사 수료 후 6년 이내
※ 논문제출기한 내에 논문심사 받고 졸업하면 되며, 논문심사 신청 학기에 연구생 등록(20만원 납부) 필수입니다.

english: ※ Please make sure to check whether you meet your own completion/graduation requirements. Use the 학사안내서 (Academic Guide) handed out at admission and the checklist in the 학사게시판 (Academic Notice Board) - 자주묻는질문 (FAQ) post.
1. Expected completion students (수료, completion of coursework)

A. There is no separate application for completion. You will be reviewed for completion if: (a) you are a master's or doctoral student, you have registered for 4 or more semesters and you have earned the credits needed for completion; or (b) you are an integrated master's-doctoral student, you have registered for 6 or more semesters and you have earned the credits needed for completion. If you think you will complete this semester, you must check whether your name is on the list.
B. 미수료 확인서 (Confirmation of Non-Completion): students who must submit it will be contacted by phone. Submit the Confirmation of Non-Completion (see attachment) by 14 Jan 2026 (Wed).
C. List of expected completion students: see the attachment (Expected completion and degree recipients).
※ If you are on the list of expected completion students but do not want to complete this semester, please submit a 수료유예원 (Request for Deferral of Completion) (see attachment) by 14 Jan 2026 (Wed).
If you do not contact the office by the deadline, it will be assumed that there are no problems and the process will go ahead.

★ (Must read) Important! ★
1. The lists of expected completion/graduation students have been announced as in the attachment.
However, please note that names may be removed from or added to the lists depending on the department office's review of completion/graduation requirements, and there may be changes.
※ The final review is in progress, including whether the approval form for courses from other departments (or undergraduate courses) has been submitted and whether completion requirements have been met.
Therefore, students themselves must also check the 학사게시판 (Academic Notice Board) - 자주 묻는 질문 (FAQ) - 학사안내서 (Academic Guide) and the completion self-check checklist.
2. If you have taken courses from other departments (or undergraduate courses) and have not yet submitted the course approval form for them, you must submit it now.
3. Please be sure to tell the staff member in charge (이소연 (Lee So-yeon)) about any special situation. This includes: you are on this semester's completion list but want to defer completion; you think you qualify for completion but are not on the list; you think you do not meet the completion requirements but are on the list; you are due to graduate but are not on the list; and similar cases.
D. Notes for non-completion / expected completion students

If you submit a 'Confirmation of Non-Completion' or a 'Request for Deferral of Completion', you become a student exceeding the standard number of semesters and you must register for the next semester. (3 credits or fewer: pay 1/2 of tuition. 4 credits or more: pay full tuition.) Please note: if a student exceeding the standard number of semesters cancels course registration and ends up with 0 credits, they will be expelled for non-registration (미등록 제적).
Students exceeding the standard number of semesters: (enrolled students) master's and doctoral: from the 5th semester; (enrolled students) integrated master's-doctoral: from the 9th semester.
※ If you neither register for courses nor take a leave of absence, you will be expelled (제적).
You cannot graduate or complete while you are on leave of absence.
Integrated master's-doctoral students pay full tuition up to the 8th semester.
D. Note: Thesis submission deadline: within 4 years after completion for master's; within 6 years after completion for doctoral.

※ You only need to pass the thesis review and graduate within the thesis submission deadline. In the semester you apply for the thesis review, you must register as a 연구생 (research student) (pay KRW 200,000 (20만원)).

2. Expected degree recipients
A. List of expected degree recipients: see the attachment (Expected completion and degree recipients).

※ Please check the list. If there is a problem, contact the department office by 14 Jan 2026 (Wed). If you do not contact the office by the deadline, it will be assumed that there are no problems and the process will go ahead.

B. Ministry of Education statistical survey: take part in the survey following the manual in Attachment 4, then send the survey completion certificate to the staff member in charge (이소연) by email by 6 Feb 2026 (Fri).
※ This applies only to expected doctoral degree recipients. Taking part in the survey is required, not optional.
C. Checking and changing your English name
Your English name (you can check it on your MySNU login screen) will be printed on your 학위기 (degree certificate / diploma) when you graduate.
Please refer to the attachment (Guide to changing the English name in the student's academic record).
If you want to change your English name, please apply by 12 Jan 2026 (Mon).

※ How to apply (for enrolled students, completed students and graduates): MySNU → 학사정보시스템 (Academic Information System) → 학적변동 (Change of Academic Status) → 신청 (Apply) → 학적부기재사항정정 (Correction of Academic Record Details)
※ You can apply to change your English name by attaching a copy of your passport or a copy of your Alien Registration Card.
※ Your Korean and English names are printed on the degree certificate (diploma), and the degree certificate cannot be reissued.
3. Note
- The certificate of completion and the certificate of degree can be issued from the afternoon of the degree conferment ceremony (mysnu).
